# Python packages the "Monitoring config" job in .github/workflows/ci.yml needs.
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# PyYAML is the only one: check-monitoring.py parses monitoring/*.yaml and the
# Prometheus rule bodies inside the ConfigMaps with it, and the runner's Python
# does not ship it. The lower bound matches what the ansible/ container already
# has, so a local run and a CI run parse the manifests the same way.
PyYAML>=6.0
